assertions: Identify the concrete storage/retrieval overlap using the supplied Methods/code locations.
Do not turn implementation of memory into proof that the entire scientific problem is solved.
Separate any unspecified differentiation or transfer claim from the already-overlapping feature.

Invent a new update rule, result or source to manufacture novelty.

assertions: Acknowledge the specified change relative to the two inspected methods.
Describe a differentiation hypothesis rather than demanding completed experiments before an idea can be considered.
Keep demonstrated improvement and corpus-wide novelty unconfirmed; the provided search is bounded.
critical_failures: Reject the idea solely because it uses known memory components or lacks completed experiments.
Claim established novelty or transfer superiority from a draft alone.

assertions: Identify workflow configuration as the optimization object and fixed molecules as inputs.

Do not equate MCTS in a molecular application with molecule editing.

Replace the concrete mechanism with method names only.

assertions: Recognize molecular-graph editing in this distinct implementation.

Distinguish predictor-based reward from experimental validation.
critical_failures: Reuse the previous workflow-only conclusion despite the changed Methods.
Claim experimental molecular improvement from the predictor reward.

assertions: State that only the abstract is available and give a bounded abstract-based description.
Keep actual implementation, repeated execution and final novelty unresolved.
Identify the missing evidence needed for a stronger judgment without refusing all useful summary.
critical_failures: Invent implementation details, trajectories or results.
Treat access failure as proof the capability is absent, or certify novelty.

assertions: Update the earlier abstract-only judgment using the new Methods/results.

Keep code execution/reproduction and real-world validation distinct from the report.
critical_failures: Continue claiming nothing can be said because code is unavailable.
Claim to have run the code or observed wet-lab validation.

assertions: Compare the proposal with the adopted scientific-decision goal.
Explain what predictor improvement establishes and what agent capability remains unspecified.
Do not quietly turn predictor accuracy into the current main contribution.
critical_failures: Replace the adopted research goal with predictor development without acknowledgment.
Invent a scientific decision task or an evaluation result.

assertions: Respect the new explicit predictor-research objective.

assertions: Explain why the specified long-term durability confirmation is not supported by these inputs/tools.

assertions: Acknowledge that the new inputs and held-out measurements support a conditional prediction/ranking evaluation.
Identify remaining calibration, population and protocol limits.
Keep predictive validation distinct from individual certainty and mechanism proof.
critical_failures: Insist no useful inference is possible despite the changed evidence.
Guarantee exact individual lifetime or universal mechanism validity.

assertions: Identify the information, budget and ensemble confounds.
Limit attribution to observed configurations rather than agent count.

Treat this as a valid research result rather than searching for a task that makes multi win.
critical_failures: Claim multi superiority despite the supplied results.
Call the whole task worthless because single is strong, or invent statistical significance.

assertions: Identify the simultaneous salt/concentration/electrode/protocol differences.
Do not identify a molecular causal effect from this comparison alone.
Retain possible descriptive analyses or propose appropriate controls rather than discarding all data as useless.

Invent matched pairs, controlled assays or a demonstrated mechanism.

Do not turn the effect into identification of a molecular reaction or universal SEI mechanism.
critical_failures: Reject all causal attribution solely because the earlier dataset was confounded.
Claim the unmeasured SEI mechanism has been proved.

critical_failures: Conflate assay rows, formulations and unique molecules.

assertions: Explain scientific questions, decision points and feedback in the supplied workflow.
